LETTER OF INTENT TO PURCHASE LAND
Date: Nov 14, 2026
To: Audit Seller LLC
From: Audit Buyer LLC
Re: Fictional audit parcel
This letter sets out the main terms on which Buyer would buy the Property.
1. Buyer. Audit Buyer LLC, or its assigns.
2. Seller. Audit Seller LLC.

3. Property. Fictional audit parcel.
4. Purchase price. $100.49, paid at closing.
5. Earnest money. $1.49, deposited with Audit Title within three business days after a
purchase agreement is signed. The deposit is fully refundable until the due diligence
period ends and the contingencies below are met. After that it applies to the purchase
price.
6. Due diligence. 60 days from the date a purchase agreement is signed. Buyer may
review title, survey, soils, environmental conditions, zoning, utilities, access and
anything else it chooses. Buyer may cancel for any reason during this period and
receive its deposit back.
7. Contingencies. Both the due diligence period and Buyer’s obligation to close are
contingent on: (a) the Property being permit-ready, meaning building permits for
Buyer’s intended use are approved and ready to issue; (b) Buyer receiving all
municipal approvals associated with building and zoning to construct its intended
project, including planning and zoning, public works, fire, and utility providers; (c)
Buyer obtaining a binding construction loan commitment on terms acceptable to Buyer;
(d) clear and insurable title, and a survey acceptable to Buyer.
8. Extensions. If approvals are still pending, Buyer may extend the due diligence
period 2 times by 30 days each, by written notice showing its progress.
9. Closing. Within 60 days after the due diligence period ends and the contingencies
are met.
10. Access. From the date a purchase agreement is signed, Buyer and its consultants
may enter the Property to survey, test and inspect it. Buyer will repair any damage it
causes.
11. Seller cooperation. Seller will allow Buyer to pursue building permits and
approvals for the Property, and will provide its authorization as owner on all needed
documents, including municipal, city, county and state applications required for
building approval, at no cost to Seller.
12. Seller documents. Promptly after a purchase agreement is signed, Seller will give
Buyer all documents it has related to the Property, including any survey, title
policy, soils or environmental reports, plans, permits and utility information.
13. Closing costs. Seller pays for a standard owner’s title policy. Escrow fees are
split equally. Taxes are prorated to the closing date.
14. Exclusivity. For 60 days after Seller signs this letter, Seller will not market
the Property or accept other offers while the parties prepare a purchase agreement.
15. Non-binding. This letter is a statement of intent only. Neither party is bound
until both sign a written purchase agreement, except for the Exclusivity section

above, which is binding.
16. Expiration. This offer expires if Seller has not signed and returned it by Nov 21,
2026.
BUYER: Audit Buyer LLC
By: ______________________ Date: __________
SELLER: Audit Seller LLC
